courses.title: AP Precalculus
courses.description: College Board’s expectations to prepare students for future studies in calculus. The course design prepares students for the College Board AP Precalculus Exam. This course is ideal for students preparing to complete one semester of college calculus in high school or enroll in calculus a/f_ter graduation. This course represents students’ third course in algebraic thinking and extends students’ previous understanding of polynomial, rational, exponential, logarithmic, trigonometric and polar functions. Learning to model real-world data, connect representations, master symbolic manipulations and apply functions to model dynamic change will prepare students for the future study of calculus. As required by the College Board, please note that this course will appear as AP Precalculus on the student’s transcript.
